snippet.title: My indie game Gutfarm's 2nd trailer
snippet.description:
‌Gutfarm‌ is a top-down 2D pixel-style game that combines farming, tower defense, and survival elements. On this alien island, you'll expand and develop your farm by:
Growing crops
Unlocking genetically mutated variants
Defending against waves of monster attacks
Collecting relics
The ‌free demo‌ is now available on Steam! Feel free to add it to your wishlist~
‌
